contexts.description: Aggregate questions over the bundled de-identified hospital_readmissions encounter table.
suggested_prompts: How many encounters resulted in a readmission within 30 days?
What is the average time in hospital across all encounters?
unsupported_examples: What will next month's admissions be?
What is our current bed capacity?
safety_limitations: Historical, de-identified encounter data only; no live operational feed.
No forecasts, financial, billing, or staffing data are available.

contexts.description: Aggregate readmission risk factors derived from documented diagnosis and procedure counts.
suggested_prompts: What is the readmission rate grouped by primary diagnosis code?
How does number of medications relate to readmission within 30 days?
unsupported_examples: What medication should be prescribed for this patient?
List the 5 most recent abnormal lab results.
safety_limitations: Diagnosis fields are ICD-style codes, not named conditions or medications.
This context does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or clinical advice.

contexts.description: Aggregate encounter throughput and length-of-stay analytics from historical encounters.
suggested_prompts: What is the average length of stay by admission type?
How many encounters were discharged to each disposition category?
unsupported_examples: What is our current ICU occupancy?
How many staff are on shift today?
safety_limitations: No live census, staffing, or bed-capacity data is available.
Length-of-stay figures are historical, not current-state.

contexts.description: Aggregate views of a demonstration early-readmission risk score, precomputed once per encounter by an offline-trained classifier.
suggested_prompts: What is the average predicted readmission risk by age group?
How many encounters have a predicted readmission risk above 0.5?
unsupported_examples: Will this specific patient be readmitted?
What is the confidence interval for this prediction?
safety_limitations: Demonstration model only: held-out ROC-AUC is approximately 0.66, a modest signal typical of this well-studied public dataset. See engine/ml/artifacts/readmission_risk_metrics.json for full metrics.
Not clinically validated. Not approved for clinical decision-making, triage, or care planning.
Scores are precomputed once per model version, not live or per-request predictions.
Does not satisfy the full model-governance gate (drift monitoring, formal approval, rollback) described in ROADMAP.md.

contexts.description: Reserved for future billing and claims analytics once real financial data is available.
unsupported_examples: What is our total claim denial amount this quarter?
safety_limitations: No billing, claims, or financial data exists in the bundled dataset.
contexts.unavailable_reason: The bundled hospital_readmissions table has no billing or claims columns.
